title: intake-state.json (v1) - state of every Generalist uid's current entry, for the keep-alive release and the uid pages
description: One document, rewritten atomically by the intake worker (never edited by hand). One row per uid: its CURRENT entry. Keep-alive (RULES-v2 6.6) goes to a row whose state is intake, needs_correction, held, pass_unscored or overflow, EXCEPT when disqualified is true, or when state is pass_unscored and preview.beats_start is false. state refused and scored never get it (former champions are a separate list owned by the release job). The consumer applies the 2-uids-per-coldkey cap and the 25 % total cap itself.

generated_at.description: UTC, when this document was written

round.description: 2 for the round after the first Generalist round

check_script_sha256.description: hash of the published checker the states come from

state.description: intake = commitment seen, stage 0 not finished (6 h promise); needs_correction = 24 h correction window open; refused = REFUSED (also: no working correction in time, or void after a confirmed misdeclaration); held = MISDECLARATION candidate, 'held, under review'; pass_unscored = PASS, preview pending or done, no official score yet; overflow = qualified for a window but did not get a place; scored = has an official result (keep-alive over)

since.description: UTC time the entry entered this state

preview.description: the automatic preview (RULES-v2 5.2: about 1,000 public items, within 24 h of PASS); null until the entry has PASS

start_score.description: the start's score on the same items (for start none: the best listed start)

disqualified.description: true after a confirmed misdeclaration or a disqualification under 3.8 or 11.2: no keep-alive

lineage_result_sha256.description: sha256 of the published stage-0 result JSON of this entry revision
